scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && pnpm test:schema && pnpm --filter @interwar/web --fail-if-no-match test
scripts.test:vk: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @interwar/web --fail-if-no-match exec playwright test --config=playwright.vk.config.ts
scripts.test:telegram: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @interwar/web --fail-if-no-match exec playwright test --config=playwright.telegram.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && node --test scripts/test-wasm-replay.mjs && pnpm --filter @interwar/web --fail-if-no-match smoke
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm test:e2e
